prompt: clang PowerPC mcrbits CR-bit tracking optimization level enabled
answer: Clang enables PowerPC CR-bit tracking by default at **-O2 and higher**. For **POWER8 and later**, it is enabled by default regardless of optimization level. Use `-mcrbits` to enable or `-mno-crbits` to disable it.
